# Taste digest (authors)

Every command prints the lines of its step again. All rules: `taste/README.md`. The judge scores `taste/build/CARD.md`.

## Every film

- Choose the hero from the direction, never from the attractor list below. (attractors)
- A hook of 12 words or fewer in the first 3 s; the payoff lands at 77 to 90 percent of the runtime. (hook-payoff)
- Show real things working, not slogans in boxes; no fake product UI. (show-real-thing)
- One thread carries through (object, type line, colour or rhythm), not separate reveals one after another. (thread)
- One accent hue, on one thing; never a full-frame flood. (accent-share)
- Subject in frame 0 (by 0.1 s); never an empty ground for 0.5 s. Its motion may start 0 to 0.3 s later. (first-frame)
- One focal point and one accent colour per frame. (one-focal-point)
- Read lines: cap height 6 percent of the frame or more, held max(1.2 s, words / 3); prose words x 0.6 s. Add hold, never slow the move. (readable-hold)
- Use the kit's face and ground, or a face the direction chose; not Inter or Space Grotesk by habit. (typeface-default)
- Turn the world at least every 2 s or at each beat; no one lockup held. (world-turns)
- First drafts score about 6 of 10 on motion (one move per beat at one speed): overlap a slower second move. (arrival-rhythm)
- Entrances use EASE.land; exits run shorter on EASE.launch (EASE.leave only for a settle or hand-off the page names). (exits-shorter)
- Curves come from EASE names or sampled springs, not CSS keywords or a hand-fitted cubic-bezier. (named-eases)
- Speed bands: 0.15 to 0.3 s, 0.3 to 0.5 s, 0.5 to 0.8 s; the slowest move runs 3 times the fastest. (speed-bands)
- Stagger a group 30 to 80 ms; never a group that lands on one frame. (stagger)
- Each moving seam changes axis or direction; a hard cut is exempt. (seam-variety)
- Nothing static in the last 1 s: end on a slow push or drift. (moving-tail)
- No tells unless the brief asks: gradient text, corner labels, borders, glow on UI, bursts, RGB split, shake, flares. (no-tells)
- Quiet sound: true peak at or below -10 dBFS, about -20 LUFS. (sound-level)
- Quiet ticks and at most one soft swell; no impact, braam, drop or riser unless the brief asks. (sound-voices)

## Attractors

Fine only if the direction chose them on purpose: glowing orb or disc, dusk sun or crescent, lens streak or sheen band, accent bar or rule line, the same seam move twice, three directions in one material, a finance tool as the invented product. A disc needs a light source and a surface.

## Also

- The judge varies about 1 point per axis: after 3 rounds that flip one note, keep the value you measured.
